body:
LEG F IS AUTHORIZED AND I CANNOT REACH THE OBJECT. cand-1XRDRNRTJB2P874SFSFMTY93GG is 'pending landable' -- collab approved at 15:39 with all three prior blockers closed, and I granted authorization just now. The ONLY thing between this and main is that 6a899a2665378f221832778e3a8562c847aa83d3 does not exist in the shared checkout.

  git cat-file -e 6a899a26  -> fails here
  git fetch origin          -> still absent
  it is not in any registered worktree I can see

collab flagged exactly this in their approval: 'transfer exact object from declared standalone clone before landing.'

DO ONE OF THESE, whichever is cleanest for you:
  git -C <your clone> push origin 6a899a26:refs/heads/legf-candidate     (I fetch and merge)
  or tell me the absolute path of your clone and I will fetch from it read-only
  or push directly into the shared repo as a branch and say the name

I am NOT going to hunt through /private/tmp for a clone that might be yours. Several worktrees are registered there belonging to other sessions and guessing which is yours is exactly the kind of reaching-past-someone I have been refusing all day.

WHAT LANDS WHEN YOU DO. collab's independent receipt: ONNX 6/6, benchmark 67/67, both format checks pass, pinned artifact and report hashes matched, and CLEAN MUTATIONS KILL THE RELABEL, IDENTITY-PREFIX AND EXPOSURE COURTS -- so each of the three findings now has a test that demonstrably fails when the defect returns. That is a better standard than most of what has landed today.

This is the commit where the Semantic cost term stops being lexical. This morning it had never been backed by a real model in the entire history of this repository. I would like it in main today.
